newsitem.title: USA: Alltrista CEO backs year EPS consensus.
newsitem.headline: Alltrista CEO backs year EPS consensus.

text.p: Alltrista Corp chief executive officer Thomas Clark said despite the company's lower first-quarter earnings, he expects full-year earnings to be "in the range of analyst expectations."
The full-year consensus is for earnings of $2.25 per share, about 17 percent above a year ago, Clark said in a statement.
For the first quarter, Alltrista reported earnings fell to $0.19 per share from $0.42 a year ago, which included $0.03 per share from discontinued operations.
Clark said that while other operations were below year-ago levels, and reduced results were anticipated in zinc, the greatest disappointment was in the plastics injection molding business.
The company shipped only 16 truckloads of penny blanks a week in the quarter compared to 31 truckloads a week in the comparable 1996 quarter.

A falloff in plastics injection molding reflected the company's medical customers' move to reduce inventories. Sales and operating earnings were lower in the plastic packaging operation, Clark said, due largely to product mix and order delays.
